_comment: Source of truth for the Starter Pack catalog. The builder computes symbols/size/version per pack at build time; only id/name/description/free/repos are authored here. repos use GitHub owner/name slugs (also the jcm repo_id).

packs.name: Node.js Essentials
packs.description: Pre-indexed: Node.js core, Express 4.x, Fastify, and Koa.

packs.name: FastAPI
packs.description: Complete FastAPI framework index. Routing, DI, security, and middleware.

packs.name: Django
packs.description: Django framework index. ORM, views, middleware, auth, admin.

packs.name: Flask
packs.description: Flask micro-framework index. Core, Blueprints, Jinja2 integration, CLI.

packs.name: React
packs.description: React core + ReactDOM index. Hooks, reconciler, fiber, events.

packs.name: LangChain
packs.description: LangChain Python index. Chains, agents, retrievers, memory, output parsers.

packs.name: Laravel
packs.description: Laravel framework index. Eloquent, Blade, routing, middleware, queues, events.

packs.name: Spring Boot
packs.description: Spring Boot index. Auto-config, actuator, web, data, security starters.

packs.name: Anthropic SDK (Python + TS)
packs.description: Official Anthropic Python and TypeScript SDK index. Messages, streaming, tools, batches.

packs.name: MCP SDK (Python + TS)
packs.description: Model Context Protocol SDK index. Server, client, transports, tool definitions.
